Title: General Availability: Azure Site Recovery replication to Azure

Body.Content: Now you can replicate the Hyper-V virtual machines running in your datacenter to Azure for disaster recovery protection—and recover them there, as needed. If you want to continue to use the service at general availability pricing, no action is required. If you wish to discontinue the use of the service, unprotect your virtual machines in the Azure Management Portal. For more information, go to Site Recovery. For a comprehensive look at pricing, go to Azure Site Recovery Pricing Details.
Body.Markdown:
Now you can replicate the Hyper-V virtual machines running in your datacenter to Azure for disaster recovery protection—and recover them there, as needed. If you want to continue to use the service at general availability pricing, no action is required. If you wish to discontinue the use of the service, unprotect your virtual machines in the Azure Management Portal .

For more information, go to Site Recovery . For a comprehensive look at pricing, go to Azure Site Recovery Pricing Details .
